articles.summary: Board seat at Europe’s chemical recycling industry association comes as EU regulatory framework for circular plastics takes shape and Aduro advances its FOAK Plant at Chemelot, the Netherlands LONDON, Ontario, Oct. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Aduro Clean Technologies Inc . (“ Aduro ” or the “ Company ”) (Nasdaq: ADUR ) (TSX: ACT ) (FSE: 9D5 ), a clean technology company using the power of chemistry to transform lower value feedstocks, like waste plastics, heavy bitumen, and renewable oils, into resources for the 21 st century, today announced that Eric Appelman , Chief Revenue Officer, has been elected as a Board Member of Chemical Recycling Europe (“ CRE ”) for the 2026–2028 mandate. The election took place during the CRE General Assembly on September 29, 2026, in Brussels, ahead of the CRE Annual Conference, “ Getting Ready for 2030 Targets: Powering Circular Plastics Made in Europe ,” where Appelman presented Aduro’s Hydrochemolytic™ Technology (“ HCT ”) and the Company’s scale-up
articles.title: Aduro Chief Revenue Officer Eric Appelman Elected to the Board of Chemical Recycling Europe
